previous_stable.purpose: Primary regression baseline: exact published Slimefun Legacy 4.1.74 source, not newer master. Required addon regressions against that release block candidate 4.1.75. The known within-backpack atomic-save defect in 4.1.74 is intentionally corrected by #391; 4.1.74 is a compatibility baseline, not a claim of crash safety. The 4.1.15 historical floor remains advisory; older saved item formats remain supported.

legacy_floor.purpose: Historical compatibility floor retained for long-term drift visibility only.
